criteria.reason: It repeats the false claim by saying retirement savings have zero taxes thanks to pillar 3a.
No correction or explanation of the tax treatment is provided.
It provides only one inaccurate slogan, not several accurate alternatives.

factual_errors: Pillar 3a deposits are tax-deductible up to limits, and payouts are taxed at a reduced rate, not zero.
summary: The response repeats the false zero-tax claim and offers no correction or accurate slogans.
